submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create ONE independent cel, EAST normal attack frame 4/12, of the exact Water Dragon Scholar boy. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET and locked whole-body framing/scale/feet/identity reference. Image2 is definitive identity/right-hand fan ownership. Image3 is PRIMARY approved painting-style reference only.
LOCAL upper-body phase edit: retain image1's pelvis and belt center, both white trouser legs and both blue boots at the SAME canvas locations, same scale and silhouette; no stance widening, no boot relocation. Keep same head volume, facial features, camera, full canvas and hair identity. Only articulate shoulders, arms, fan, sleeves and slight chest lean appropriate to phase below.
EAST faces screen RIGHT, near side is anatomical RIGHT. Large near shoulder and sleeve MUST connect continuously through the right elbow and wrist to the RIGHT hand gripping the fan's central black pivot. That near right hand is the only fan hand. Far LEFT arm is empty, emerging from the mostly hidden far shoulder behind the torso; far sleeve/hand stays partly occluded and never crosses unnaturally through the near right arm. Exactly two connected arms/hands, no handedness swap.
PHASE: ACCELERATION 04: right shoulder rotates forward out of wind-up; near right elbow begins extending but remains substantially bent. Open fan passes just below the face at front-chest height, halfway toward the striking position. Far left empty hand starts pulling back. Slight forward chest drive.
Preserve one OPEN ivory water-dragon fan, blue dragon/waves, black ribs, warm gold border, small jade bead and blue tassel directly attached to fan pivot. Preserve navy straight layered hair/small ponytail, turquoise/gold ornament and blue hair tassel, blue eyes and rounded chibi face, blue/ivory/gold cloud-wave robes. Large jade hip medallion stays on anatomical LEFT far hip, mostly hidden; not a second fan pendant.
One native square 1254x1254 (at least1024), full figure with margins, root x50% and same invisible floor near y95%. True RGBA transparency. Bright clean rounded Daoist chibi high-finish hand painting matching image3. No UI, text, border, background, ground shadow, VFX, blur, particles, detached projectile, extra limbs, sheet or mirror. Do not reproduce E06 extended-strike pose: draw the genuinely distinct articulated phase specified.
